ledgerMapping.coverage: Actual workspace and enterprise mappers preserve explicit all-day provenance and timed instants; scheduling component/display tests execute under both configured non-UTC zones.
ledgerMapping.additionalSharedDateCoverage: calendarDateDisplay and EntryPopup runtime assertions are included verbatim above; no separate shared-date incident record was found.
limits: The ledger-listed packages/emulators/msgraph/tests/calendar.test.ts and eventMapping.test.ts are not members of this dedicated artifact. Related expanded mapper tests are included, not an exact execution match to those listed files.
React component action boundaries are mocked; these reports do not establish persisted editor saves or deployed browser behavior.
Incident closure and named operational ownership are not established by passing assertions.
